transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the Harbor Point Properties restructuring review. As you know, we have an $8 million term loan secured by the borrower's office building, equipment, and receivables. Harbor Point has requested a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral due to weaker-than-expected occupancy reducing their debt-service coverage. Before I can record the final terms, I need each of you -- risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management -- to give me your findings update and identify the supporting document or policy behind any recommendations. I'll include those sources in the meeting minutes. Let's start with risk. What are you seeing?
